اقتطعا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَطَعَا (iqtaṭaʕā) /iq.ta.tˤa.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# اُقْتُطِعَا (uqtuṭiʕā) /uq.tu.tˤi.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# اِقْتَطِعَا (iqtaṭiʕā) /iq.ta.tˤi.ʕaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
